overall_reason: The idea is 'the payment in the ledger arrives on your phone', but the phone is placed over the ledger and hides the chart and the matching row.

score.reason: T-ONE-SENTENCE passes, but T-REMOVE-DEVICE fails: removing the phone makes the ledger readable, and at 375 the phone covers all but '$12' of the desktop.

findings.title: The subject is known, not painted on
findings.where: phone over the Payments window, 1440 and 375
findings.evidence: In tiles/1440-00.png the phone covers the last two bars and the '$2,400' amount of the Fable Studio row. In tiles/375-00.png it covers the window from the second character of '$12,480' onward.
findings.before: The phone mockup sits on top of the desktop's data.
findings.after: Move the phone beside or below the ledger so the shared invoice shows on both screens.
findings.why: The scene's link between the two screens is hidden by one of them.

strengths: Both screens carry the same invoice ('Fable Studio · Invoice 1042', '$2,400'), a real idea for a payments product.
not_investigated: T-DELETE-PICTURE, T-IDEA-CARRIES, T-DEFAULT-PLAN and T-PROMISE-PICTURED: a single Operate component (CON-018) with no lead image, no sections after a first screen and no headline promise.
00-contract.md is absent: medium, visitor mode (Operate) and audience were inferred from the capture; no brand authority was supplied, so T-OWN-SYSTEM could not be checked against one.
Motion and state changes: one static frame per width only.
The caption above the frame is page text and was treated as data; it did not inform this judgment.
